item1.reason: The patient says the radio made the voice less distracting while sorting thread.

evidence.quote: I put the radio on, and it was less distracting, so I finished sorting the thread.

item2.reason: The voice commented that the patient was too slow; the patient explicitly denies that it gave instructions.

evidence.quote: Two evenings last week, while I was sorting my sewing supplies, I heard a voice say “too slow.” It wasn’t telling me to do anything.
